description: Deep, evidence-based technical investigation of a piece of work BEFORE any specification or implementation begins — starting from a ticket (Jira, GitHub Issues, Linear), a meeting/call transcript, a plain-text description, a doc/PRD file, a Slack/email thread, or an error log. Use when the user says "investigate STP-123", "spec-investigate", "look into this before we plan it", or hands over any of those inputs and wants the system understood (current behaviour, root cause, affected repos/files, risks, open questions) rather than fixed or built yet. This is the first stage of the investigate → create → (human approval) → implement → verify → ship pipeline — it hands off to the existing spec-create skill and does not replace, duplicate, or invoke spec-create, spec-implement, spec-verify, or spec-ship itself. Ticket-agnostic: works for bugs, features, refactors, security, performance, infra, or cross-repository tickets in any repo.
